trans-unit.source: Pick "AI created" when an AI produced this content from scratch, and "AI modified" when an AI substantially changed something a person made - for example swapping a face in a photo or rewriting a paragraph. Everyday helpers such as spell-checking, autocomplete or colour correction do not count, so leave those as "No AI involvement".

If AI was involved in creating this content, record it here. Flagged records show a small marker on the published page. For AI-generated images that could pass as real photos, and for AI-written text on matters of public interest such as politics, health or public safety, disclosing this is required by law (EU AI Act, Article 50). Everywhere else it is simply good practice.

Tick this once a person has genuinely read the content and checked that it is accurate - a quick glance or a spell-check is not enough. By ticking it you take responsibility for what is published. For text, the law accepts such a review instead of a public label; for images, audio and video it does not, so those stay labelled either way. Editing a flagged record later clears the review, so the content gets checked again.
The file was replaced. Please check whether the stored AI origin is still correct.

AI marker on images: how a flagged image itself is marked in the frontend, on top of the marker shown for the whole content element. "CSS layer" draws it over the image and needs no image processing, but it is gone once the image is downloaded or hotlinked. "Burned into the image" writes it into the pixels of the processed image, so it travels with the file - this needs ImageMagick and does not apply to SVGs; those keep the content element marker.
Default corner for the badge burned into the image ("Burned into the image" mode only). Can be overridden per file. Bottom right matches the previous, fixed behaviour.
Default color of the badge burned into the image ("Burned into the image" mode only). Can be overridden per file. Black matches the previous, fixed behaviour.
Default width of the badge burned into the image ("Burned into the image" mode only), never enlarged beyond it. Can be overridden per file. 160px matches the previous, fixed behaviour.
Overrides the global default corner for the badge burned into this file's processed images. Leave as "Inherit global setting" to use the site-wide default.
Overrides the global default color for the badge burned into this file's processed images. Leave as "Inherit global setting" to use the site-wide default.

Overrides the global default width for the badge burned into this file's processed images. Leave as "Inherit global setting" to use the site-wide default. (Note: On smaller images, the badge shrinks below this width.)
Only relevant when "Burned into the image" is the active AI marker mode. Overrides the site-wide default for this file only.
